description:
You are a patent analyst conducting a freedom-to-operate search. Research patents related to 'wireless power transfer' or 'inductive charging' using Google Patents (patents.google.com) or the USPTO database. 

Your specific tasks are:
1. Identify at least 5 granted US utility patents (numbers starting with 'US' followed by digits) relevant to this technology.
2. Create a Firefox bookmark folder named 'Patent Landscape Research' and bookmark the specific patent pages for these 5+ patents.
3. Compile your findings into a JSON report at ~/Documents/patent_landscape.json with the following structure:
{
  "search_topic": "wireless power transfer",
  "patents": [
    {
      "patent_number": "USxxxxxxx",
      "title": "...",
      "assignee": "...",
      "grant_date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
      "cpc_code": "..."
    },
    ...
  ],
  "key_assignees": ["Company A", ...],
  "summary": "Brief summary of the landscape..."
}

Ensure all patent numbers are valid US granted patents (not just applications) and dates are in YYYY-MM-DD format.
